procedure: Run the RC-06 candidate Vite development server with live tmux-backed data.
Open session %24 and select the Commits panel.
Warm the e1d24955 commit detail, then collapse it before recording.
Expand and collapse e1d24955 five times and capture the peak CommitSection actualDuration for each expansion.
Use nearest-rank p95 across the five samples.
